title: Improving cycle stability and kinetics of rechargeable aluminum–CO2 batteries using functional cathode materials
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5612-5618
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00608B, Paper
Gustavo Diaz, Shuya Wei
A novel gas diffusion electrode, featuring high surface area and conductivity, was developed to enhance the cycle stability and kinetics of aluminum-carbon dioxide (Al–CO2) batteries.
